wp__dash__progress_sub: {done} of {total} milestones done. You're right on schedule.
wp__dash__no_tasks: No open tasks. You're all caught up.
wp__dash__no_phases: Add timeline phases to see your stages here.
wp__timeline__sub: Auto-generated from your wedding date. Check off milestones as you go — everything is editable.
wp__timeline__error: We couldn't load your timeline. Please try again.
wp__timeline__empty_body: Add phases like "12+ months" or "1 month to go", then fill each with the tasks you want to check off as the day approaches.
wp__timeline__no_event: Set up your wedding details first to start a timeline.
wp__tasks__sub: Everything to do, organized by stage. Click a task to see the full detail.
wp__tasks__error: We couldn't load your tasks. Please try again.
wp__tasks__empty_body: Add tasks and drag them across To do, In progress and Done as you make your way through the plan.
wp__tasks__no_event: Set up your wedding details first to start adding tasks.
wp__tasks__hint_owner: Who's responsible for this task — e.g. Alex, Sophie, or Both. Just a name.
wp__tasks__hint_cost: Rough budget for this task. Numbers only — e.g. 4200.
wp__tasks__hint_vendor: The supplier or company tied to this task — e.g. the photographer or florist you're using.
wp__tasks__hint_blocked: What has to happen before you can start this. A dependency — e.g. "Guest list" before sending invitations. Leave empty if nothing's blocking it.
wp__budget__on_track_desc: You're {amount} under your total budget. Nicely balanced.
wp__budget__error: We couldn't load your budget. Please try again.
wp__budget__no_event: Set up your wedding details first to start a budget.
wp__budget__hint_total: Your overall wedding budget. Spent, Remaining and the ring are all measured against this. Click to edit.
wp__budget__hint_estimated: What you expect this category to cost.
wp__budget__hint_actual: The real, quoted or agreed price once you know it.
wp__budget__hint_paid: How much you've paid so far — the progress bar fills as this approaches Actual.
wp__vendors__sub: Everyone you're working with — contracts, contacts, and balances in one place.
wp__vendors__error: We couldn't load your vendors. Please try again.
wp__vendors__empty_body: Add the vendors you're considering or have booked — photographer, florist, venue, and more.
wp__vendors__no_event: Set up your wedding details first to start adding vendors.
wp__vendors__hint_status: Where you are with this vendor: Shortlist (considering) → In talks (getting quotes) → Booked (confirmed).
wp__vendors__hint_rating: Your own 1–5 rating to compare vendors. Click a star to set it, click it again to clear.
wp__vendors__hint_price: The vendor's total cost — the full price for their service.
wp__vendors__hint_deposit: How much you've already paid them. Shown on the card as 'deposit paid'.
wp__ai__sub: Ask in plain language. It knows your date, budget, guests, and vendors — and can update the plan.
wp__ai__greeting:
Hi! I'm your Ovation planning assistant. I know your wedding is in {days} days at {venue} for {guests} guests, with a {budget} budget.

Ask me anything — or tap a suggestion below.
wp__ai__hello: Hi! I'm your Ovation planning assistant. Ask me anything about your wedding — I'll answer based on your real plan. In **Action** mode I can add tasks, budget items and vendors for you (you confirm first).
wp__ai__error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
wp__ai__no_event: Set up your wedding details first to use the assistant.
wp__ai__mode_hint_label: What do Plan and Action mean?
wp__ai__mode_hint: Plan mode: the assistant only gives advice — it never changes anything. Action mode: it can propose adding tasks, budget items and vendors, which you always confirm before they're saved.
wp__ai__starter_2: How should I budget for flowers?
wp__ai__starter_3: Add a task to book a videographer
wp__ai__plan_prompt: Help me plan our whole wedding. Before you build anything, ask me a few quick questions in one short message — our total budget, rough guest count, the style or vibe we're going for, our location or season, and any must-haves or things to avoid. Wait for my answers, then propose a complete plan (timeline phases, the essential tasks under each, budget categories with rough amounts, and set our total budget) for me to confirm.
wp__ai__decide_prompt: You decide for me — don't ask any questions. Use sensible defaults for a typical wedding and propose a complete plan right now: timeline phases, the essential tasks under each, budget categories with rough amounts, and a suggested total budget, all for me to confirm.
